course.title: Unit 4 Eat Well【例句】
course.description: Section B How do we make healthy eating choices?

sentences.content: List what you want to eat tomorrow.
sentences.english: List what you want to eat tomorrow
sentences.chinese: 列出你明天想吃的食物。

sentences.content: Discuss if your choices are healthy.
sentences.english: Discuss if your choices are healthy
sentences.chinese: 讨论你的选择是否健康。

sentences.content: Healthy eating is important for a healthy body and mind.
sentences.english: Healthy eating is important for a healthy body and mind
sentences.chinese: 健康饮食对身心健康至关重要。

sentences.content: Both what we eat and how we eat are important!
sentences.english: Both what we eat and how we eat are important !
sentences.chinese: 我们吃什么以及怎么吃都很重要！

sentences.content: For example, some people have fast food every week.
sentences.english: For example , some people have fast food every week
sentences.chinese: 例如，有些人每周都吃快餐。

sentences.content: It is easy and delicious!
sentences.english: It is easy and delicious !
sentences.chinese: 简单又美味！

sentences.content: But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.
sentences.english: But it often has lots of salt , fat , and sugar
sentences.chinese: 但它通常含有大量的盐、脂肪和糖分。

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: That makes us put on weight.
sentences.english: That makes us put on weight
sentences.chinese: 这会导致我们发胖。

wordDetails.definition: make（第三人称单数现在时）: 使

sentences.content: Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later.
sentences.english: Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later
sentences.chinese: 频繁食用披萨和汉堡等快餐食品，日后可能会引发心脏问题。

sentences.content: If you cook your own meals instead, you can make healthy balanced meals.
sentences.english: If you cook your own meals instead , you can make healthy balanced meals
sentences.chinese: 如果你选择自己做饭，就能做出健康均衡的餐食。

sentences.content: Eating three meals a day is important.
sentences.english: Eating three meals a day is important
sentences.chinese: 一日三餐很重要。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: But some people don’t have breakfast.
sentences.english: But some people don't have breakfast
sentences.chinese: 但有些人不用早餐。

sentences.content: Maybe they don’t feel hungry in the morning, or they are too busy to eat anything.
sentences.english: Maybe they don't feel hungry in the morning , or they are too busy to eat anything
sentences.chinese: 或许他们早上不觉得饿，又或者他们太忙了没时间吃东西。

sentences.content: But food gives us energy.
sentences.english: But food gives us energy
sentences.chinese: 但食物能为我们提供能量。

wordDetails.definition: give（第三人称单数现在时）: 给予

sentences.content: It is easy to feel sleepy and find it hard to focus on our work or studies if we don’t eat breakfast.
sentences.english: It is easy to feel sleepy and find it hard to focus on our work or studies if we don't eat breakfast
sentences.chinese: 如果不吃早餐，很容易感到困倦，难以集中精力工作或学习。

sentences.content: Some people also eat too many sweet things.
sentences.english: Some people also eat too many sweet things
sentences.chinese: 有些人还吃了太多甜食。

sentences.content: Ice cream, sweets, and chocolate are delicious, but they usually have lots of sugar.
sentences.english: Ice cream , sweets , and chocolate are delicious , but they usually have lots of sugar
sentences.chinese: 冰淇淋、糖果和巧克力虽然美味，但通常含有大量糖分。

sentences.content: This can cause tooth problems.
sentences.english: This can cause tooth problems
sentences.chinese: 这可能导致牙齿问题。

sentences.content: When you want a snack, why don’t you have some fruit instead?
sentences.english: When you want a snack , why don't you have some fruit instead ?
sentences.chinese: 想吃零食的时候，何不来点水果呢？

sentences.content: After all, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
sentences.english: After all , an apple a day keeps the doctor away
sentences.chinese: 毕竟，一天一苹果，医生远离我。

wordDetails.definition: keep（第三人称单数）: 保持

sentences.content: Remember: You are what you eat.
sentences.english: Remember : You are what you eat
sentences.chinese: 记住：人如其食。

sentences.content: Healthy eating means eating healthy food and having good eating habits.
sentences.english: Healthy eating means eating healthy food and having good eating habits
sentences.chinese: 健康饮食意味着食用健康食物并养成良好的饮食习惯。

wordDetails.definition: mean（第三人称单数）: 意味着

sentences.content: I have some good eating habits.
sentences.english: I have some good eating habits
sentences.chinese: 我有一些良好的饮食习惯。

sentences.content: I eat three meals a day, and I have them on time.
sentences.english: I eat three meals a day , and I have them on time
sentences.chinese: 我一天吃三顿饭，而且按时用餐。

sentences.content: I eat a lot of vegetables too.
sentences.english: I eat a lot of vegetables too
sentences.chinese: 我也吃很多蔬菜。

sentences.content: Some of my friends don’t like carrots or other vegetables, and they don’t eat them, but I eat all kinds of vegetables.
sentences.english: Some of my friends don't like carrots or other vegetables , and they don't eat them , but I eat all kinds of vegetables
sentences.chinese: 我的一些朋友不喜欢胡萝卜或其他蔬菜，他们都不吃这些，但我各种蔬菜都吃。

sentences.content: However, I have some bad eating habits too.
sentences.english: However , I have some bad eating habits too
sentences.chinese: 不过，我也有一些不良的饮食习惯。

sentences.content: First, I drink too many soft drinks.
sentences.english: First , I drink too many soft drinks
sentences.chinese: 首先，我喝了太多软饮料。

sentences.content: I love soft drinks because they taste so good!
sentences.english: I love soft drinks because they taste so good !
sentences.chinese: 我爱喝软饮料，因为它们味道太棒了！

sentences.content: But soft drinks usually have a lot of sugar.
sentences.english: But soft drinks usually have a lot of sugar
sentences.chinese: 但软饮料通常含有大量糖分。

sentences.content: They’re bad for me.
sentences.english: They're bad for me
sentences.chinese: 它们对我有害。

sentences.content: Second, I don’t drink enough water.
sentences.english: Second , I don't drink enough water
sentences.chinese: 其次，我喝水不够。

sentences.content: I drink water when I am thirsty, but it’s better to drink before I get thirsty.
sentences.english: I drink water when I am thirsty , but it's better to drink before I get thirsty
sentences.chinese: 我口渴时会喝水，但在感到口渴之前喝水更好。

sentences.content: In future, I should drink more water.
sentences.english: In future , I should drink more water
sentences.chinese: 今后，我应该多喝水。
